purpose: Waldatelier PWA and iOS app icon
brief: One square icon with the same kind, curious orange fox, cream muzzle, brown eyes and green neckerchief. Rich hand-painted watercolour and fine sepia touches on opaque warm ivory paper, with a few sage leaves. No text, frame, interface, logo, shadow or extra characters. Keep the portrait readable at small sizes and allow room for system masking.
maskable: Original portrait reduced to 75% and centred on warm ivory before the 512px export.
